definitions.gloss: averaging; leveling (out); smoothing out; standardization (toward an average)
definitions.explanation: The process of reducing variation across items, people, or values so that they become closer to a common average. Used both in technical/statistical contexts (smoothing data, leveling workload) and in social ones (standardization of wages, service quality, or abilities).

examples.japanese: データを{平均化|へいきんか}する。
{業務|ぎょうむ}の{負担|ふたん}を{平均化|へいきんか}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to even out the workload.

examples.japanese: {生産|せいさん}ラインの{作業量|さぎょうりょう}を{平均化|へいきんか}することで、{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: By leveling out the workload on the production line, efficiency improves.

examples.japanese: {評価|ひょうか}の{平均化|へいきんか}が{進|すす}むと、{本当|ほんとう}に{優秀|ゆうしゅう}な{社員|しゃいん}が{正|ただ}しく{評価|ひょうか}されなくなる{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: If the leveling of evaluations progresses, there is a risk that truly outstanding employees will no longer be properly appraised.

notes:
Composed of {平均|へいきん} (average) and the suffix -{化|か} (-ization, turning into). A productive -{化|か} noun that refers to the act or process of making things averaged or leveled.

USAGE:
Used across technical, business, and social contexts:
- Statistics / engineering: smoothing of measurements, data, or loads.
- Business / operations: evening out workload, production volume, or service quality.
- Social / educational: leveling of abilities, grades, or outcomes — sometimes with a negative connotation of suppressing individuality or excellence.

Can be used as a する verb: {平均化|へいきんか}する 'to average out, to level'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負荷|ふか}を{平均化|へいきんか}する: to level out the load (computing, engineering)
- {作業量|さぎょうりょう}を{平均化|へいきんか}する: to even out the workload
- データを{平均化|へいきんか}する: to average / smooth data
- {能力|のうりょく}の{平均化|へいきんか}: the leveling of abilities
- {平均化|へいきんか}が{進|すす}む: leveling progresses / becomes more pronounced

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {均一化|きんいつか}: uniformization — making things uniform or identical; stronger than {平均化|へいきんか}, which only brings values closer to an average
- {平滑化|へいかつか}: smoothing — a technical term in data processing, particularly in signal processing or image processing
- {標準化|ひょうじゅんか}: standardization — making things conform to a standard, not necessarily an average
- {一律化|いちりつか}: uniform application (across cases) — emphasizes treating everyone the same
